objective: Compute mathematically defensible cast-normalized E intervals from zero-inclusive historical aggregate output totals when gross versus net input accounting and Resourcefulness refunds are explicit; refuse to invent cast counts.

inputs.reportedInputUnits: positive integer; original source units unchanged
inputs.nominalInputCountPerCast: source-supplied, not assumed to be 10 for all recipes
inputs.maxRefundPerCast: integer [0, nominal-1] or null unknown; independent evidence required for current-Retail applicability
inputs.rankContext: explicit input and output quality ranks or UNKNOWN

forward.gross: if reported gross inputs are confirmed completed-cast inputs, casts=gross/nominal, must be exact multiple
forward.netWithBound: min casts=ceil(net/nominal); max casts=floor(net/(nominal-maxRefundPerCast)); reject impossible intervals
forward.E: [totalOutput/maxCasts, totalOutput/minCasts], using 0 lower when maxCasts is unbounded

inverse.historicalTransfer: No automatic current-Retail transfer or baseline inversion
inverse.dropChance: Not identified from aggregate output counts alone

assumptions: Zero-inclusive output totals must be explicitly established, not merely positive-output logs
Input accounting must distinguish gross completed-cast inputs from net consumed inputs
Gross supplied with unused inputs is not equivalent to gross completed-cast inputs
A maximum per-cast Resourcefulness refund is a conditional source assumption, not a measured current-patch mechanic
All results conditional on the supplied rank and recipe context; UNKNOWN cannot be silently pooled
No shared-study duplicate counted as independent holdout
Historical aggregate E intervals are not measured current-Retail E
Output co-occurrence, P and positive conditional yield extrema remain unidentified
evidenceRequest: For each TWW milling cohort recover original gross completed-cast inputs versus net consumed, unused inventory, nominal recipe input, actual completed casts, refunded herbs and output totals including zeros. Preserve exact herb/pigment ranks, skill, stats, recipe ID, patch epoch and study family; do not combine 2024 beta and live anecdotes as a matched cohort.
validatorRequest: Independently check integer feasibility of cast bounds and zero-inclusive requirement, gross/net confusion, refund-max unknown branch, non-identifiability of P, no economic promotion and study-family holdout separation.
blockers: No independently measured current-Retail zero-inclusive completed-cast TWW milling cohort for 12 keys
